name: Little Piney Creek — Lane Spring Recreation Area to Jerome Access
gaugeName: Little Piney Creek at Newburg, MO (USGS 06932000)
blurb: Little Piney Creek in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation and U.S. Forest Service accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Lane Spring Recreation Area: approximate area only. Take-out Jerome Access: exact agency access pin. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

putInAccess.operator: USDA Forest Service — Mark Twain National Forest
putInAccess.sourceName: USDA Forest Service, Mark Twain NF — EDW Recreation Opportunities record
putInAccess.note: Public river access is documented by USDA Forest Service, Mark Twain NF — EDW Recreation Opportunities record. The coordinate is USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities (Mark Twain National Forest), OBJECTID 6864; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: the USFS record is a recreation-area point, not a boat-launch feature.
putInAccess.directions: While you have the peace, quiet and tranquility of a creekside campground, the audible noise of Highway 63 can sometimes be heard in the distance.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 2024
takeOutAccess.note: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 2024 (Boat ramp (MDC)) is the managing agency's own access feature, 12 m from the USGS NHD High Resolution flowline of the Little Piney Creek. Imagery check 2026-10-30: Pin on the bank at a visible ramp, gravel landing, bridge access or bank access. Public access: Missouri Department of Conservation — Jerome Access (area page).
